title: Will and Verdict Anew
author: Astrid Crane
blurb: Odile Pemberton, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
